# Retiring the OpenPGP message dialog removes its package and UI resource bindings together

This change deletes the JS/XHTML dialog plus both chrome package entries, its title localization and its two style selectors. The shared stylesheet and neighboring dialogs remain. Earlier hidden-toggle examples from the removed dialog stay historical evidence. Named source-root queries find no external opener but cannot rule out dynamic/external consumers. No replacement dialog, packaging build or UI test was run.

Scope: Retired enigmailMsgBox dialog resources.
